using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Tilemaps;

public class MapManager : MonoBehaviour
{
    [Header("地图引用")]
    [SerializeField] private Grid grid;                 // 网格
    [SerializeField] private Tilemap groundTilemap;    // 地面层（供视觉参考）
    [SerializeField] private Tilemap obstacleTilemap;  // 障碍物层（墙/石头）

    // 单例模式，方便其他脚本直接调用 MapManager.Instance
    public static MapManager Instance { get; private set; }

    // ========== 逻辑网格（二维数组）==========
    // 以 Ground 左上角为 (0,0)，1=有障碍物，0=无障碍物
    private int[,] walkableGrid;
    public int Width { get; private set; }
    public int Height { get; private set; }
    // Ground 左上角对应的 Tilemap 坐标（用于索引 → 坐标转换）
    private Vector3Int gridOrigin;

    private void Awake()
    {
        if (Instance == null) Instance = this;
        else Destroy(gameObject);

        if (grid == null) grid = GetComponent<Grid>();
        if (groundTilemap != null)
            BuildWalkableGrid();
        else
            Debug.LogWarning("MapManager: 未指定 Ground Tilemap，无法构建网格");
    }

    /// <summary> 扫描 Tilemap 构建逻辑网格（以 Ground 左上角为原点）</summary>
    private void BuildWalkableGrid()
    {
        BoundsInt bounds = groundTilemap.cellBounds;
        Width = bounds.size.x;
        Height = bounds.size.y;
        // 左上角格子 = (minX, maxY - 1)
        gridOrigin = new Vector3Int(bounds.min.x, bounds.max.y - 1, 0);

        walkableGrid = new int[Width, Height];

        for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
        {
            for (int y = 0; y < Height; y++)
            {
                // 网格索引 (x, y) 对应 Tilemap 坐标 (gridOrigin.x + x, gridOrigin.y - y)
                Vector3Int cellPos = new Vector3Int(gridOrigin.x + x, gridOrigin.y - y, 0);
                walkableGrid[x, y] = (obstacleTilemap != null && obstacleTilemap.GetTile(cellPos) != null) ? 1 : 0;
            }
        }
    }

    // ========== 坐标转换 ==========
    // 世界坐标 → 网格索引 (0,0 在左上角)
    public Vector2Int WorldToGridIndex(Vector3 worldPos)
    {
        Vector3Int cell = grid.WorldToCell(worldPos);
        return new Vector2Int(cell.x - gridOrigin.x, gridOrigin.y - cell.y);
    }

    // 网格索引 → 世界坐标（格子中心点）
    public Vector3 GridIndexToWorld(Vector2Int gridIndex)
    {
        Vector3Int cell = new Vector3Int(gridOrigin.x + gridIndex.x, gridOrigin.y - gridIndex.y, 0);
        return grid.GetCellCenterWorld(cell);
    }

    /// <summary> 世界坐标 -> 格子坐标（兼容旧代码）</summary>
    public Vector3Int WorldToCell(Vector3 worldPosition) => grid.WorldToCell(worldPosition);

    /// <summary> 格子坐标 -> 世界坐标（格子中心点，兼容旧代码）</summary>
    public Vector3 CellToWorld(Vector3Int cellPosition) => grid.GetCellCenterWorld(cellPosition);

    // ========== 通行检测 ==========
    // 网格索引版本：0=可通行，1=有障碍物
    public bool IsWalkable(Vector2Int gridIndex) => IsWalkable(gridIndex.x, gridIndex.y);

    public bool IsWalkable(int x, int y)
    {
        if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= Width || y >= Height) return false;
        return walkableGrid[x, y] == 0;
    }

    // 世界坐标版本（兼容 PlayerController）
    public bool IsWalkable(Vector3 worldPos) => IsWalkable(WorldToGridIndex(worldPos));

    // ========== 视线检测 ==========
    /// <summary>
    /// 检查从 from 到 to 间是否有障碍物阻挡（布雷森汉姆直线算法）
    /// 返回 true = 视线畅通（无障碍物）；返回 false = 视线被阻（有障碍物）
    /// </summary>
    /// 
    public bool HasLineOfSight(Vector2Int from, Vector2Int to)
    {
        return HasLineOfSight(from, to, 0f);
    }

    public bool HasLineOfSight(Vector2Int from, Vector2Int to, float radius)
    {
        if (!IsWalkable(from) || !IsWalkable(to)) return false;

        // 将半径转换为格子数（至少为1，保证至少检测中心格子本身）
        int checkRadius = Mathf.Max(1, Mathf.CeilToInt(radius));

        int x0 = from.x, y0 = from.y;
        int x1 = to.x, y1 = to.y;

        int dx = Mathf.Abs(x1 - x0);
        int dy = Mathf.Abs(y1 - y0);
        int sx = x0 < x1 ? 1 : -1;
        int sy = y0 < y1 ? 1 : -1;
        int err = dx - dy;

        while (true)
        {
            // 检测以 (x0, y0) 为中心，边长为 (2*checkRadius+1) 的正方形区域
            bool blocked = false;
            for (int ox = -checkRadius; ox <= checkRadius; ox++)
            {
                for (int oy = -checkRadius; oy <= checkRadius; oy++)
                {
                    int checkX = x0 + ox;
                    int checkY = y0 + oy;
                    if (!IsWalkable(checkX, checkY))
                    {
                        blocked = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (blocked) break;
            }
            if (blocked) return false;

            // 到达终点
            if (x0 == x1 && y0 == y1) break;

            // Bresenham 步进
            int oldX = x0, oldY = y0;
            int e2 = 2 * err;
            bool changedX = false, changedY = false;

            if (e2 > -dy) { err -= dy; x0 += sx; changedX = true; }
            if (e2 < dx) { err += dx; y0 += sy; changedY = true; }

            // 斜角阻塞检测（防止穿墙角）
            if (changedX && changedY)
            {
                if (!IsWalkable(oldX + sx, oldY) || !IsWalkable(oldX, oldY + sy))
                    return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    // ========== A* 寻路（8方向，含对角线）==========
    private class Node
    {
        public Vector2Int pos;
        public Node parent;
        public int gCost;
        public int hCost;
        public int FCost => gCost + hCost;
    }

    // 8 方向：上/下/左/右 代价 10，对角线 代价 14（√10≈2）
    private static readonly Vector2Int[] Directions = {
        new Vector2Int(0, 1),   new Vector2Int(0, -1),
        new Vector2Int(-1, 0),  new Vector2Int(1, 0),
        new Vector2Int(-1, 1),  new Vector2Int(1, 1),
        new Vector2Int(-1, -1), new Vector2Int(1, -1),
    };
    private static readonly int[] DirectionCosts = { 10, 10, 10, 10, 14, 14, 14, 14 };

    // 对角线启发函数（Octile 距离）
    private static int Heuristic(Vector2Int a, Vector2Int b)
    {
        int dx = Mathf.Abs(a.x - b.x);
        int dy = Mathf.Abs(a.y - b.y);
        return 10 * Mathf.Max(dx, dy) + 4 * Mathf.Min(dx, dy);
    }

    /// <summary> A* 寻路，返回世界坐标路径点列表 </summary>
    public List<Vector3> FindPath(Vector3 startWorld, Vector3 targetWorld)
    {
        Vector2Int start = WorldToGridIndex(startWorld);
        Vector2Int target = WorldToGridIndex(targetWorld);

        // 起点或终点不可通行时，找最近可通行点
        if (!IsWalkable(start)) start = FindNearestWalkable(start);
        if (!IsWalkable(target)) target = FindNearestWalkable(target);
        if (!IsWalkable(start) || !IsWalkable(target)) return null;
        if (start == target) return new List<Vector3> { GridIndexToWorld(start) };

        var openList = new List<Node>();
        var openDict = new Dictionary<Vector2Int, Node>(); // O(1) 查找
        var closedSet = new HashSet<Vector2Int>();

        Node startNode = new Node { pos = start, gCost = 0, hCost = Heuristic(start, target) };
        openList.Add(startNode);
        openDict[start] = startNode;

        while (openList.Count > 0)
        {
            // 取 F 值最小的节点
            int currentIndex = 0;
            Node current = openList[0];
            for (int i = 1; i < openList.Count; i++)
            {
                if (openList[i].FCost < current.FCost ||
                    (openList[i].FCost == current.FCost && openList[i].hCost < current.hCost))
                {
                    current = openList[i];
                    currentIndex = i;
                }
            }

            openList.RemoveAt(currentIndex);
            openDict.Remove(current.pos);
            closedSet.Add(current.pos);

            // 到达目标，回溯路径
            if (current.pos == target)
            {
                List<Vector3> path = new List<Vector3>();
                Node node = current;
                while (node != null)
                {
                    path.Add(GridIndexToWorld(node.pos));
                    node = node.parent;
                }
                path.Reverse();
                return path;
            }

            // 遍历 8 个方向
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
            {
                Vector2Int neighborPos = current.pos + Directions[i];

                if (closedSet.Contains(neighborPos) || !IsWalkable(neighborPos)) continue;

                // 对角线移动时，检查两侧格子是否可通行（防止穿墙角）
                if (i >= 4)
                {
                    Vector2Int side1 = new Vector2Int(current.pos.x + Directions[i].x, current.pos.y);
                    Vector2Int side2 = new Vector2Int(current.pos.x, current.pos.y + Directions[i].y);
                    if (!IsWalkable(side1) || !IsWalkable(side2)) continue;
                }

                int newGCost = current.gCost + DirectionCosts[i];

                if (openDict.TryGetValue(neighborPos, out Node existing))
                {
                    if (newGCost < existing.gCost)
                    {
                        existing.gCost = newGCost;
                        existing.parent = current;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    Node neighbor = new Node
                    {
                        pos = neighborPos,
                        parent = current,
                        gCost = newGCost,
                        hCost = Heuristic(neighborPos, target)
                    };
                    openList.Add(neighbor);
                    openDict[neighborPos] = neighbor;
                }
            }
        }

        return null; // 找不到路径
    }

    // ========== 最近可达点（A* 找不到路时的备用）==========
    public Vector2Int FindNearestWalkable(Vector2Int target)
    {
        if (IsWalkable(target)) return target;

        for (int radius = 1; radius < 20; radius++)
        {
            for (int dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++)
            {
                for (int dy = -radius; dy <= radius; dy++)
                {
                    if (Mathf.Abs(dx) != radius && Mathf.Abs(dy) != radius) continue;
                    Vector2Int checkPos = target + new Vector2Int(dx, dy);
                    if (IsWalkable(checkPos)) return checkPos;
                }
            }
        }
        return target; // 保底
    }
}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// 地牢生成器 — BFS邻接放置房间，共享墙壁开门洞，无走廊。
/// </summary>
public class DungeonGenerator
{
    public List<List<RoomData>> Layers { get; private set; } = new();
    public TileGrid GlobalGrid { get; private set; }

    private DungeonConfig _config;
    private TilePrototype[] _allProtos;
    private TilePrototype _wallProto;
    private TilePrototype _floorProto;
    private TilePrototype _doorProto;

    public DungeonGenerator(DungeonConfig config, TilePrototype[] allProtos,
        TilePrototype wallProto, TilePrototype floorProto, TilePrototype doorProto)
    {
        _config = config;
        _allProtos = allProtos;
        _wallProto = wallProto;
        _floorProto = floorProto;
        _doorProto = doorProto;
    }

    public TileGrid Generate(int seed = 0)
    {
        if (seed != 0) Random.InitState(seed);

        GlobalGrid = new TileGrid(_config.maxMapWidth, _config.maxMapHeight, Vector2Int.zero, _config.tileSize);

        for (int layer = 0; layer < _config.layerCount; layer++)
        {
            Debug.Log($"Layer {layer + 1}/{_config.layerCount}");
            var rooms = GenerateLayer(layer);
            Layers.Add(rooms);

            foreach (var room in rooms)
                if (room.TileGrid != null)
                    GlobalGrid.Blit(room.TileGrid, room.Position.x, room.Position.y);

            MergeAdjacentRooms(rooms);
        }

        return GlobalGrid;
    }

    // ==================== BFS 邻接放置 ====================

    private List<RoomData> GenerateLayer(int layerIndex)
    {
        var rooms = new List<RoomData>();
        int count = _config.roomsPerLayer;
        if (count == 0) return rooms;

        // 房间 0: 起始房间，居中放置
        int layerOffsetY = layerIndex * (_config.roomMaxHeight * 3);
        int cx = _config.maxMapWidth / 2;
        int cy = 10 + layerOffsetY;

        RoomType t0 = RoomType.Start;
        int w0 = Random.Range(_config.roomMinWidth, _config.roomMaxWidth + 1);
        int h0 = Random.Range(_config.roomMinHeight, _config.roomMaxHeight + 1);
        var room0 = RoomGenerator.Generate(w0, h0, new Vector2Int(cx - w0 / 2, cy), t0,
            _allProtos, _wallProto, _floorProto, _doorProto);
        if (room0.TileGrid != null) rooms.Add(room0);

        // BFS 队列
        var queue = new Queue<int>();
        queue.Enqueue(0);

        while (rooms.Count < count && queue.Count > 0)
        {
            int parentIdx = queue.Dequeue();
            var parent = rooms[parentIdx];

            // 尝试在四个方向放置子房间
            var sides = new[] { (0, -1), (0, 1), (-1, 0), (1, 0) }; // N S W E
            Shuffle(sides);

            foreach (var (sx, sy) in sides)
            {
                if (rooms.Count >= count) break;

                RoomType type = rooms.Count == count - 1 ? RoomType.Exit
                    : (Random.value < 0.15f ? RoomType.Treasure : RoomType.Normal);

                int w = Random.Range(_config.roomMinWidth, _config.roomMaxWidth + 1);
                int h = Random.Range(_config.roomMinHeight, _config.roomMaxHeight + 1);

                Vector2Int pos = CalcAdjacentPos(parent, w, h, sx, sy);

                if (pos.x < 0 || !IsPositionFree(rooms, pos, w, h)) continue;

                var room = RoomGenerator.Generate(w, h, pos, type,
                    _allProtos, _wallProto, _floorProto, _doorProto);
                if (room.TileGrid != null)
                {
                    rooms.Add(room);
                    queue.Enqueue(rooms.Count - 1);
                }
            }
        }

        // 如果房间数不够，随机散放剩余
        while (rooms.Count < count)
        {
            RoomType type = rooms.Count == count - 1 ? RoomType.Exit
                : (Random.value < 0.15f ? RoomType.Treasure : RoomType.Normal);
            int w = Random.Range(_config.roomMinWidth, _config.roomMaxWidth + 1);
            int h = Random.Range(_config.roomMinHeight, _config.roomMaxHeight + 1);

            Vector2Int pos = ScatterPosition(rooms, w, h, layerOffsetY);
            if (pos.x < 0) { w = Mathf.Max(_config.roomMinWidth, w - 2); h = Mathf.Max(_config.roomMinHeight, h - 2); pos = ScatterPosition(rooms, w, h, layerOffsetY); }
            if (pos.x < 0) break;

            var room = RoomGenerator.Generate(w, h, pos, type, _allProtos, _wallProto, _floorProto, _doorProto);
            if (room.TileGrid != null) rooms.Add(room);
        }

        return rooms;
    }

    private Vector2Int CalcAdjacentPos(RoomData parent, int w, int h, int sx, int sy)
    {
        // sx,sy: (-1,0)=左 (1,0)=右 (0,1)=上 (0,-1)=下
        int px = parent.Position.x;
        int py = parent.Position.y;
        int pw = parent.Width;
        int ph = parent.Height;

        // 对齐中心
        int centerP = (sx != 0) ? (py + ph / 2) : (px + pw / 2);
        int centerN = (sx != 0) ? (h / 2) : (w / 2);
        int align = centerP - centerN;

        if (sx == -1) return new Vector2Int(px - w, align);              // 左边
        if (sx == 1) return new Vector2Int(px + pw, align);             // 右边
        if (sy == -1) return new Vector2Int(align, py - h);              // 上边
        return new Vector2Int(align, py + ph);                          // 下边
    }

    private bool IsPositionFree(List<RoomData> rooms, Vector2Int pos, int w, int h)
    {
        if (pos.x < 0 || pos.y < 0 || pos.x + w > _config.maxMapWidth || pos.y + h > _config.maxMapHeight)
            return false;

        var rect = new RectInt(pos.x, pos.y, w, h);
        foreach (var r in rooms)
            if (rect.Overlaps(r.Bounds)) return false;
        return true;
    }

    private Vector2Int ScatterPosition(List<RoomData> rooms, int w, int h, int layerOffset)
    {
        for (int a = 0; a < 50; a++)
        {
            int x = Random.Range(2, _config.maxMapWidth - w - 2);
            int y = Random.Range(2 + layerOffset, Mathf.Min(layerOffset + _config.roomMaxHeight * 4, _config.maxMapHeight - h - 2));
            if (IsPositionFree(rooms, new Vector2Int(x, y), w, h))
                return new Vector2Int(x, y);
        }
        return new Vector2Int(-1, -1);
    }

    // ==================== 共享墙壁合并 ====================

    private void MergeAdjacentRooms(List<RoomData> rooms)
    {
        int floorIdx = System.Array.IndexOf(_allProtos, _floorProto);
        int doorIdx = System.Array.IndexOf(_allProtos, _doorProto);
        if (floorIdx < 0) floorIdx = 0;
        if (doorIdx < 0) doorIdx = 0;

        var floorTile = new TileData { prototypeIndex = floorIdx, walkable = true, category = TilePrototype.Category.Floor };
        var doorTile = new TileData { prototypeIndex = doorIdx, walkable = true, category = TilePrototype.Category.Door };

        for (int i = 0; i < rooms.Count; i++)
        {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < rooms.Count; j++)
            {
                var a = rooms[i];
                var b = rooms[j];

                var overlap = GetSharedBorder(a, b);
                if (overlap.valid)
                {
                    // 在共享边上开门洞：取中间 ~1/3 长度
                    int len = overlap.end - overlap.start + 1;
                    int doorLen = Mathf.Max(1, len / 3);
                    int doorStart = overlap.start + (len - doorLen) / 2;

                    for (int k = doorStart; k < doorStart + doorLen; k++)
                    {
                        int gx = overlap.isX ? k : overlap.fixedCoord;
                        int gy = overlap.isX ? overlap.fixedCoord : k;

                        // 替换共享边两侧的墙壁为门
                        ReplaceWallWith(GlobalGrid, gx, gy, doorTile);
                        // 对应的对面格子（另一个房间的内部边缘）
                        if (overlap.isX)
                            ReplaceWallWith(GlobalGrid, gx, gy + overlap.dirSign, doorTile);
                        else
                            ReplaceWallWith(GlobalGrid, gx + overlap.dirSign, gy, doorTile);

                        // 也确认相邻的 floor tiles 连通
                        if (overlap.isX)
                        {
                            SetIfEmpty(GlobalGrid, gx, gy + 1, floorTile);
                            SetIfEmpty(GlobalGrid, gx, gy - 1, floorTile);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            SetIfEmpty(GlobalGrid, gx + 1, gy, floorTile);
                            SetIfEmpty(GlobalGrid, gx - 1, gy, floorTile);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private (bool valid, bool isX, int fixedCoord, int start, int end, int dirSign)
        GetSharedBorder(RoomData a, RoomData b)
    {
        var ra = a.Bounds;
        var rb = b.Bounds;

        // 检查水平相邻（a在左，b在右，或b在左，a在右）
        if (ra.xMax == rb.xMin && ra.yMax > rb.yMin && ra.yMin < rb.yMax)
        {
            int yStart = Mathf.Max(ra.yMin, rb.yMin);
            int yEnd = Mathf.Min(ra.yMax, rb.yMax) - 1;
            if (yEnd >= yStart)
                return (true, false, ra.xMax, yStart, yEnd, 0); // isX=false, vertical border at x=ra.xMax
        }
        if (rb.xMax == ra.xMin && ra.yMax > rb.yMin && ra.yMin < rb.yMax)
        {
            int yStart = Mathf.Max(ra.yMin, rb.yMin);
            int yEnd = Mathf.Min(ra.yMax, rb.yMax) - 1;
            if (yEnd >= yStart)
                return (true, false, ra.xMin, yStart, yEnd, 0);
        }

        // 检查垂直相邻
        if (ra.yMax == rb.yMin && ra.xMax > rb.xMin && ra.xMin < rb.xMax)
        {
            int xStart = Mathf.Max(ra.xMin, rb.xMin);
            int xEnd = Mathf.Min(ra.xMax, rb.xMax) - 1;
            if (xEnd >= xStart)
                return (true, true, ra.yMax, xStart, xEnd, 1); // isX=true, horizontal border at y=ra.yMax
        }
        if (rb.yMax == ra.yMin && ra.xMax > rb.xMin && ra.xMin < rb.xMax)
        {
            int xStart = Mathf.Max(ra.xMin, rb.xMin);
            int xEnd = Mathf.Min(ra.xMax, rb.xMax) - 1;
            if (xEnd >= xStart)
                return (true, true, ra.yMin, xStart, xEnd, -1);
        }

        return (false, false, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    }

    private void ReplaceWallWith(TileGrid grid, int x, int y, TileData newTile)
    {
        if (!grid.InBounds(x, y)) return;
        var tile = grid.GetTile(x, y);
        if (tile.category == TilePrototype.Category.Wall)
            grid.SetTile(x, y, newTile);
    }

    private void SetIfEmpty(TileGrid grid, int x, int y, TileData tile)
    {
        if (!grid.InBounds(x, y)) return;
        if (grid.GetTile(x, y).IsEmpty)
            grid.SetTile(x, y, tile);
    }

    private static void Shuffle<T>(T[] arr)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.Length; i++)
        {
            int j = Random.Range(i, arr.Length);
            (arr[i], arr[j]) = (arr[j], arr[i]);
        }
    }

    public static RoomData Generate(int width, int height, Vector2Int position, RoomType type,
        TilePrototype[] prototypes, TilePrototype wallProto, TilePrototype floorProto,
        TilePrototype doorProto)
    {
        var room = new RoomData
        {
            Width = width,
            Height = height,
            Position = position,
            Type = type
        };

        // 四边全部墙壁，无门洞
        var fixedCells = new Dictionary<Vector2Int, TilePrototype>();
        for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
        {
            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
            {
                bool isBorder = x == 0 || x == width - 1 || y == 0 || y == height - 1;
                if (isBorder)
                    fixedCells[new Vector2Int(x, y)] = wallProto;
            }
        }

        var wfc = new WaveFunctionCollapse(prototypes);
        room.TileGrid = wfc.Collapse(width, height, position, fixedCells);

        return room;
    }

    public void Render(TileGrid grid, TilePrototype[] prototypes)

        _tileSize = grid.TileSize;

        int idx = 0;
        for (int x = 0; x < grid.Width; x++)
        {
            for (int y = 0; y < grid.Height; y++)
            {
                var tile = grid.GetTile(x, y);
                if (tile.IsEmpty || tile.prototypeIndex < 0 || tile.prototypeIndex >= prototypes.Length) continue;

                var proto = prototypes[tile.prototypeIndex];
                var sr = GetRenderer(idx++);
                sr.sprite = proto.sprite;
                sr.color = proto.color;
                sr.transform.position = grid.GridToWorld(x, y);
                sr.transform.localScale = Vector3.one * _tileSize;
                sr.sortingOrder = proto.category == TilePrototype.Category.Wall ? 1 : 0;
                sr.gameObject.SetActive(true);
            }
        }

        _activeCount = idx;

        var go = new GameObject("Tile", typeof(SpriteRenderer));
        go.transform.SetParent(_container);
        go.SetActive(false);

        _pool.Add(sr);

    {
        for (int i = 0; i < _activeCount && i < _pool.Count; i++)

using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// 2D 瓦片网格 — 纯数据，提供读写和查询。
/// </summary>
public class TileGrid
{
    public int Width { get; private set; }
    public int Height { get; private set; }
    public Vector2Int Origin { get; private set; }
    public float TileSize { get; private set; }

    private TileData[,] _tiles;

    public TileGrid(int width, int height, Vector2Int origin, float tileSize = 1f)
    {
        Width = width;
        Height = height;
        Origin = origin;
        TileSize = tileSize;
        _tiles = new TileData[width, height];
        for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
                _tiles[x, y] = TileData.Empty;
    }

    public TileData GetTile(int x, int y)
    {
        if (!InBounds(x, y)) return TileData.Empty;
        return _tiles[x, y];
    }

    public void SetTile(int x, int y, TileData data)
    {
        if (!InBounds(x, y)) return;
        _tiles[x, y] = data;
    }

    public bool InBounds(int x, int y) => x >= 0 && x < Width && y >= 0 && y < Height;

    public bool IsWalkable(int x, int y)
    {
        if (!InBounds(x, y)) return false;
        return _tiles[x, y].walkable && !_tiles[x, y].IsEmpty;
    }

    public Vector3 GridToWorld(int x, int y)
    {
        float cx = Origin.x + (x + 0.5f) * TileSize;
        float cy = Origin.y - (y + 0.5f) * TileSize;
        return new Vector3(cx, cy, 0f);
    }

    public Vector2Int WorldToGrid(Vector3 worldPos)
    {
        int x = Mathf.FloorToInt((worldPos.x - Origin.x) / TileSize);
        int y = Mathf.FloorToInt((Origin.y - worldPos.y) / TileSize);
        return new Vector2Int(x, y);
    }

    public TileGrid GetRegion(int x, int y, int w, int h)
    {
        var region = new TileGrid(w, h, new Vector2Int(Origin.x + x, Origin.y - y), TileSize);
        for (int rx = 0; rx < w; rx++)
            for (int ry = 0; ry < h; ry++)
                region._tiles[rx, ry] = GetTile(x + rx, y + ry);
        return region;
    }

    public void Blit(TileGrid src, int dstX, int dstY)
    {
        for (int x = 0; x < src.Width; x++)
            for (int y = 0; y < src.Height; y++)
                SetTile(dstX + x, dstY + y, src._tiles[x, y]);
    }

    public bool HasLineOfSight(Vector2Int a, Vector2Int b, float radiusCells)
    {
        int dx = Mathf.Abs(b.x - a.x);
        int dy = Mathf.Abs(b.y - a.y);
        int sx = a.x < b.x ? 1 : -1;
        int sy = a.y < b.y ? 1 : -1;
        int err = dx - dy;
        int x = a.x, y = a.y;
        int steps = dx + dy;

        for (int i = 0; i <= steps; i++)
        {
            int r = Mathf.CeilToInt(radiusCells);
            bool blocked = false;
            for (int ox = -r; ox <= r && !blocked; ox++)
                for (int oy = -r; oy <= r && !blocked; oy++)
                    if (!IsWalkable(x + ox, y + oy)) blocked = true;
            if (blocked) return false;
            if (x == b.x && y == b.y) return true;
            int e2 = 2 * err;
            if (e2 > -dy) { err -= dy; x += sx; }
            if (e2 < dx) { err += dx; y += sy; }
        }
        return true;
    }

    // A* 寻路，8-direction
    private static readonly Vector2Int[] _dirs8 = {
        new(0,1), new(1,1), new(1,0), new(1,-1),
        new(0,-1), new(-1,-1), new(-1,0), new(-1,1)
    };
    private static readonly int[] _costs = { 10, 14, 10, 14, 10, 14, 10, 14 };

    public List<Vector2Int> FindPath(Vector2Int start, Vector2Int end)
    {
        if (!IsWalkable(end.x, end.y))
            end = FindNearestWalkable(end);
        if (!IsWalkable(start.x, start.y) || !IsWalkable(end.x, end.y))
            return null;

        var open = new List<(int f, Vector2Int pos)>();
        var cameFrom = new Dictionary<Vector2Int, Vector2Int>();
        var gScore = new Dictionary<Vector2Int, int>();
        var closed = new HashSet<Vector2Int>();

        gScore[start] = 0;
        open.Add((Heuristic(start, end), start));

        while (open.Count > 0)
        {
            open.Sort((a, b) => a.f.CompareTo(b.f));
            var current = open[0].pos;
            open.RemoveAt(0);
            if (current == end) return ReconstructPath(cameFrom, current);
            closed.Add(current);

            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
            {
                var neighbor = current + _dirs8[i];
                if (closed.Contains(neighbor) || !IsWalkable(neighbor.x, neighbor.y)) continue;
                if (i == 1 || i == 3 || i == 5 || i == 7)
                {
                    var d = _dirs8[i];
                    if (!IsWalkable(current.x + d.x, current.y) ||
                        !IsWalkable(current.x, current.y + d.y)) continue;
                }

                int tentative = gScore[current] + _costs[i];
                if (!gScore.ContainsKey(neighbor) || tentative < gScore[neighbor])
                {
                    gScore[neighbor] = tentative;
                    cameFrom[neighbor] = current;
                    int f = tentative + Heuristic(neighbor, end);
                    int idx = open.FindIndex(o => o.pos == neighbor);
                    if (idx >= 0) open[idx] = (f, neighbor);
                    else open.Add((f, neighbor));
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private List<Vector2Int> ReconstructPath(Dictionary<Vector2Int, Vector2Int> cameFrom, Vector2Int current)
    {
        var path = new List<Vector2Int> { current };
        while (cameFrom.ContainsKey(current))
        {
            current = cameFrom[current];
            path.Add(current);
        }
        path.Reverse();
        return path;
    }

    private int Heuristic(Vector2Int a, Vector2Int b)
    {
        int dx = Mathf.Abs(a.x - b.x);
        int dy = Mathf.Abs(a.y - b.y);
        return 10 * Mathf.Max(dx, dy) + 4 * Mathf.Min(dx, dy);
    }

    private Vector2Int FindNearestWalkable(Vector2Int pos)
    {
        for (int r = 1; r <= 20; r++)
            for (int ox = -r; ox <= r; ox++)
                for (int oy = -r; oy <= r; oy++)
                {
                    var p = new Vector2Int(pos.x + ox, pos.y + oy);
                    if (IsWalkable(p.x, p.y)) return p;
                }
        return pos;
    }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using Random = UnityEngine.Random;

/// <summary>
/// 波函数坍塌 — 纯算法，输入原型集 + 尺寸 + 约束 → 输出 TileGrid。
/// </summary>
public class WaveFunctionCollapse
{
    private TilePrototype[] _prototypes;
    private int _width, _height;
    private bool[][,] _possible;      // _possible[p][x,y] = 原型p在(x,y)是否可能
    private int[,] _entropy;         // 每个cell的可能原型数
    private int[,] _collapsed;       // -1=未坍塌 其他=原型索引
    private TilePrototype[,] _initialFixed; // 初始化时固定的瓦片(约束)

    private static readonly Vector2Int[] _dirs = { Vector2Int.up, Vector2Int.down, Vector2Int.right, Vector2Int.left };
    private int _totalCells, _collapsedCount;
    private int _maxAttempts;

    public WaveFunctionCollapse(TilePrototype[] prototypes, int maxAttempts = 50)
    {
        _prototypes = prototypes;
        _maxAttempts = maxAttempts;
    }

    /// <summary>执行坍塌，返回生成的 TileGrid，失败返回 null</summary>
    public TileGrid Collapse(int width, int height, Vector2Int origin,
        Dictionary<Vector2Int, TilePrototype> fixedCells = null)
    {
        for (int attempt = 0; attempt < _maxAttempts; attempt++)
        {
            var result = TryCollapse(width, height, origin, fixedCells);
            if (result != null) return result;
            Debug.LogWarning($"WFC attempt {attempt + 1} failed, retrying...");
        }
        Debug.LogError("WFC: all attempts exhausted");
        return null;
    }

    private TileGrid TryCollapse(int width, int height, Vector2Int origin,
        Dictionary<Vector2Int, TilePrototype> fixedCells)
    {
        _width = width;
        _height = height;
        _totalCells = width * height;
        _collapsedCount = 0;

        InitializeData(fixedCells);

        while (_collapsedCount < _totalCells)
        {
            // 找最低熵 cell
            var cell = FindLowestEntropy();
            if (cell.x < 0) return null; // 矛盾

            // 坍塌
            if (!CollapseCell(cell.x, cell.y)) return null;

            // 传播约束
            if (!Propagate(cell.x, cell.y)) return null;
        }

        return BuildTileGrid(origin);
    }

    private void InitializeData(Dictionary<Vector2Int, TilePrototype> fixedCells)
    {
        _possible = new bool[_prototypes.Length][,];
        _entropy = new int[_width, _height];
        _collapsed = new int[_width, _height];
        _initialFixed = new TilePrototype[_width, _height];

        // 初始化所有cell为全部原型可能
        for (int p = 0; p < _prototypes.Length; p++)
        {
            _possible[p] = new bool[_width, _height];
            for (int x = 0; x < _width; x++)
                for (int y = 0; y < _height; y++)
                    _possible[p][x, y] = true;
        }

        // 初始熵 = 原型数
        for (int x = 0; x < _width; x++)
            for (int y = 0; y < _height; y++)
            {
                _entropy[x, y] = _prototypes.Length;
                _collapsed[x, y] = -1;
            }

        // 应用固定约束
        if (fixedCells != null)
        {
            foreach (var kv in fixedCells)
            {
                int x = kv.Key.x, y = kv.Key.y;
                if (x >= 0 && x < _width && y >= 0 && y < _height)
                {
                    int idx = Array.IndexOf(_prototypes, kv.Value);
                    if (idx >= 0)
                    {
                        ForceCollapse(x, y, idx);
                        _initialFixed[x, y] = kv.Value;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void ForceCollapse(int x, int y, int prototypeIndex)
    {
        for (int p = 0; p < _prototypes.Length; p++)
            _possible[p][x, y] = (p == prototypeIndex);
        _entropy[x, y] = 1;
    }

    private Vector2Int FindLowestEntropy()
    {
        int minEntropy = int.MaxValue;
        var candidates = new List<Vector2Int>();

        for (int x = 0; x < _width; x++)
        {
            for (int y = 0; y < _height; y++)
            {
                if (_collapsed[x, y] >= 0) continue;
                if (_entropy[x, y] == 0) return new Vector2Int(-1, -1); // 矛盾
                if (_entropy[x, y] < minEntropy)
                {
                    minEntropy = _entropy[x, y];
                    candidates.Clear();
                    candidates.Add(new Vector2Int(x, y));
                }
                else if (_entropy[x, y] == minEntropy)
                {
                    candidates.Add(new Vector2Int(x, y));
                }
            }
        }

        return candidates.Count > 0 ? candidates[Random.Range(0, candidates.Count)] : new Vector2Int(-1, -1);
    }

    private bool CollapseCell(int x, int y)
    {
        // 收集可能的原型及权重
        float totalWeight = 0f;
        var weighted = new List<(int idx, float weight)>();
        for (int p = 0; p < _prototypes.Length; p++)
        {
            if (_possible[p][x, y])
            {
                totalWeight += _prototypes[p].weight;
                weighted.Add((p, _prototypes[p].weight));
            }
        }

        if (weighted.Count == 0) return false;

        // 按权重随机选择
        float r = Random.Range(0f, totalWeight);
        float accum = 0f;
        int chosen = weighted[0].idx;
        foreach (var w in weighted)
        {
            accum += w.weight;
            if (r <= accum) { chosen = w.idx; break; }
        }

        _collapsed[x, y] = chosen;
        _collapsedCount++;

        // 更新该cell的可能状态
        for (int p = 0; p < _prototypes.Length; p++)
            _possible[p][x, y] = (p == chosen);
        _entropy[x, y] = 1;

        return true;
    }

    private bool Propagate(int startX, int startY)
    {
        var queue = new Queue<Vector2Int>();
        queue.Enqueue(new Vector2Int(startX, startY));

        while (queue.Count > 0)
        {
            var cell = queue.Dequeue();
            if (_collapsed[cell.x, cell.y] < 0) continue;

            int collapsedProto = _collapsed[cell.x, cell.y];

            foreach (var dir in _dirs)
            {
                int nx = cell.x + dir.x;
                int ny = cell.y + dir.y;
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= _width || ny < 0 || ny >= _height) continue;
                if (_collapsed[nx, ny] >= 0) continue;

                // 筛选邻居可能原型：必须与已坍塌的cell兼容
                bool anyRemoved = false;
                for (int p = 0; p < _prototypes.Length; p++)
                {
                    if (!_possible[p][nx, ny]) continue;
                    if (!TilePrototype.CanConnect(_prototypes[collapsedProto], _prototypes[p], dir))
                    {
                        _possible[p][nx, ny] = false;
                        anyRemoved = true;
                    }
                }

                if (anyRemoved)
                {
                    int newEntropy = 0;
                    for (int p = 0; p < _prototypes.Length; p++)
                        if (_possible[p][nx, ny]) newEntropy++;

                    if (newEntropy == 0) return false; // 矛盾
                    _entropy[nx, ny] = newEntropy;
                    queue.Enqueue(new Vector2Int(nx, ny));
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private TileGrid BuildTileGrid(Vector2Int origin)
    {
        var grid = new TileGrid(_width, _height, origin);
        for (int x = 0; x < _width; x++)
            for (int y = 0; y < _height; y++)
            {
                int p = _collapsed[x, y];
                if (p < 0) p = 0; // 安全回退
                var proto = _prototypes[p];
                grid.SetTile(x, y, new TileData
                {
                    prototypeIndex = p,
                    walkable = proto.walkable,
                    category = proto.category
                });
            }
        return grid;
    }
}

        Vector2 targetVelocity = _moveInput * moveSpeed;
        Vector3 currentPos = _rb.position;

            if (canMoveX) finalPos.x = nextPosX.x;
            if (canMoveY) finalPos.y = nextPosY.y;
            _rb.MovePosition(finalPos);
        }
    }

public abstract class BaseEnemy : MonoBehaviour, IDamageable, ISkillCaster
{

    [Header("技能配置")]

    [SerializeField] protected List<SkillData> _skillDataList;      // 敌人使用的技能数据

    protected Rigidbody2D rb;
    protected Transform playerTarget;
    protected TileManager mapManager;
    protected bool isDead = false;

    protected float lastHitTime = -10f;

    /// <summary>敌人持有的技能实例（运行时创建）</summary>
    protected List<SkillInstance> _skillInstances = new();

    /// <summary>技能实例列表（供外部读取，如侵蚀技能弹窗）</summary>
    public System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<SkillInstance> SkillInstances => _skillInstances;

    // ---------- ISkillCaster ----------
    public Transform CasterTransform => transform;

    /// <summary>敌人目标方向：指向玩家</summary>
    public virtual Vector2 GetTargetDirection()
    {
        if (playerTarget == null) return Vector2.down;
        return (playerTarget.position - transform.position).normalized;
    }

    public float GetAttackStrength() => attackStrength;

    // A* 寻路状态
    private List<Vector3> currentPath;
    private int pathIndex;
    private float lastPathUpdateTime = -10f;
    private Vector3 lastKnownTargetPos; // 记录上次寻路时玩家的位置

    protected virtual void Start()
    {
        rb = GetComponent<Rigidbody2D>();
        rb.freezeRotation = true; // 冻结旋转，防止碰墙打转

        mapManager = TileManager.Instance;
        GameObject player = GameObject.FindGameObjectWithTag("Player");
        if (player != null) playerTarget = player.transform;

        CircleCollider2D circle = GetComponent<CircleCollider2D>();
        if (circle != null) colliderRadius = circle.radius * transform.localScale.x;

        // 通过 SkillLibrary 工厂创建技能实例
        _skillInstances.Clear();
        if (_skillLibrary != null)
        {
            foreach (var data in _skillDataList)
            {
                if (data == null) continue;
                SkillInstance instance = _skillLibrary.CreateSkillInstance(data.skillId);
                if (instance != null)
                    _skillInstances.Add(instance);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>AI 驱动释放技能，子类在 FixedUpdate 中调用</summary>
    protected void TryCastSkill(int index)
    {
        if (index < 0 || index >= _skillInstances.Count) return;
        _skillInstances[index].TryCast(this, GetTargetDirection());
    }

    /// <summary>驱动所有技能的冷却</summary>
    protected void TickSkillCooldowns(float deltaTime)
    {
        foreach (var skill in _skillInstances)
        {
            skill.TickCooldown(deltaTime);
        }

    // ========== 寻路移动主逻辑 ==========
    // 视线畅通 → 直线追击；视线被挡 → A* 寻路绕行
    protected void MoveTowardsPlayer()
    {
        if (isDead || playerTarget == null) return;

        float distance = Vector2.Distance(transform.position, playerTarget.position);
        if (distance > detectionRange)
        {
            currentPath = null;
            rb.velocity = Vector2.zero;
            return;
        }

        if (mapManager == null)
        {
            MoveDirectlyTowards(playerTarget.position);
            return;
        }

        Vector2Int enemyCell = mapManager.WorldToGridIndex(transform.position);
        Vector2Int playerCell = mapManager.WorldToGridIndex(playerTarget.position);

        // 视线检测：HasLineOfSight 返回 true = 视线畅通（无障碍物）
        if (mapManager.HasLineOfSight(enemyCell, playerCell, colliderRadius * 0.5f))
        {
            // 视线畅通，直接朝角色移动
            currentPath = null;
            MoveDirectlyTowards(playerTarget.position);
        }
        else
        {
            // 视线被障碍物阻挡，使用 A* 寻路绕行
            // 仅在路径耗尽、或玩家移动超过阈值且间隔到期时重新计算路径，防止频繁重算导致方向抖动
            bool needUpdate = currentPath == null ||
                              pathIndex >= currentPath.Count ||
                              (Time.time - lastPathUpdateTime >= pathUpdateInterval &&
                               Vector3.Distance(playerTarget.position, lastKnownTargetPos) > 0.5f);

            if (needUpdate)
            {
                currentPath = mapManager.FindPath(transform.position, playerTarget.position);
                // 跳过第一个路径点（敌人当前格子中心），直接朝下一个格子移动
                pathIndex = (currentPath != null && currentPath.Count > 1) ? 1 : 0;
                lastPathUpdateTime = Time.time;
                lastKnownTargetPos = playerTarget.position;
            }

            if (currentPath != null && pathIndex < currentPath.Count)
            {
                // 沿路径点移动
                Vector3 waypoint = currentPath[pathIndex];
                MoveDirectlyTowards(waypoint);

                // 到达当前路径点，进入下一个
                if (Vector2.Distance(transform.position, waypoint) < pathReachThreshold)
                    pathIndex++;
            }
            else
            {
                // 找不到路径，尝试直接朝角色
                MoveDirectlyTowards(playerTarget.position);
            }
        }
    }

    // ========== 通用移动方法（速度驱动，物理引擎自动处理碰撞与滑墙）==========
    private void MoveDirectlyTowards(Vector3 target)
    {
        Vector2 direction = ((Vector2)(target - transform.position)).normalized;
        rb.velocity = direction * moveSpeed;
    }

    public virtual void TakeDamage(float damage)
    {
        if (isDead) return;
        health -= damage;
        if (health <= 0) Die();
        else StartCoroutine(FlashWhite());
    }

    protected virtual void Die()
    {
        isDead = true;
        rb.velocity = Vector2.zero;
        Destroy(gameObject, 0.5f);
    }

    private IEnumerator FlashWhite()
    {
        SpriteRenderer sr = GetComponent<SpriteRenderer>();
        if (sr != null) { Color c = sr.color; sr.color = Color.white; yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.1f); sr.color = c; }
    }

    public int Width { get; private set; }
    public int Height { get; private set; }

    private void BuildWalkableGrid()

        // 左上角格子 = (minX, maxY - 1)
        gridOrigin = new Vector3Int(bounds.min.x, bounds.max.y - 1, 0);

        walkableGrid = new int[Width, Height];

        for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
        {
            for (int y = 0; y < Height; y++)
            {
                // 网格索引 (x, y) 对应 Tilemap 坐标 (gridOrigin.x + x, gridOrigin.y - y)
                Vector3Int cellPos = new Vector3Int(gridOrigin.x + x, gridOrigin.y - y, 0);
                walkableGrid[x, y] = (obstacleTilemap != null && obstacleTilemap.GetTile(cellPos) != null) ? 1 : 0;
            }
        }
    }

    // ========== 坐标转换 ==========
    // 世界坐标 → 网格索引 (0,0 在左上角)
    public Vector2Int WorldToGridIndex(Vector3 worldPos)
    {
        Vector3Int cell = grid.WorldToCell(worldPos);
        return new Vector2Int(cell.x - gridOrigin.x, gridOrigin.y - cell.y);
    }

    // 网格索引 → 世界坐标（格子中心点）
    public Vector3 GridIndexToWorld(Vector2Int gridIndex)
    {
        Vector3Int cell = new Vector3Int(gridOrigin.x + gridIndex.x, gridOrigin.y - gridIndex.y, 0);
        return grid.GetCellCenterWorld(cell);
    }

    /// <summary> 世界坐标 -> 格子坐标（兼容旧代码）</summary>
    public Vector3Int WorldToCell(Vector3 worldPosition) => grid.WorldToCell(worldPosition);

    /// <summary> 格子坐标 -> 世界坐标（格子中心点，兼容旧代码）</summary>
    public Vector3 CellToWorld(Vector3Int cellPosition) => grid.GetCellCenterWorld(cellPosition);

    // ========== 通行检测 ==========
    // 网格索引版本：0=可通行，1=有障碍物
    public bool IsWalkable(Vector2Int gridIndex) => IsWalkable(gridIndex.x, gridIndex.y);

    public bool IsWalkable(int x, int y)
    {
        if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= Width || y >= Height) return false;
        return walkableGrid[x, y] == 0;
    }

    // 世界坐标版本（兼容 PlayerController）
    public bool IsWalkable(Vector3 worldPos) => IsWalkable(WorldToGridIndex(worldPos));

    // ========== 视线检测 ==========
    /// <summary>
    /// 检查从 from 到 to 间是否有障碍物阻挡（布雷森汉姆直线算法）
    /// 返回 true = 视线畅通（无障碍物）；返回 false = 视线被阻（有障碍物）
    /// </summary>
    /// 
    public bool HasLineOfSight(Vector2Int from, Vector2Int to)
    {
        return HasLineOfSight(from, to, 0f);
    }

    public bool HasLineOfSight(Vector2Int from, Vector2Int to, float radius)
    {
        if (!IsWalkable(from) || !IsWalkable(to)) return false;

        // 将半径转换为格子数（至少为1，保证至少检测中心格子本身）
        int checkRadius = Mathf.Max(1, Mathf.CeilToInt(radius));

        int x0 = from.x, y0 = from.y;
        int x1 = to.x, y1 = to.y;

        int dx = Mathf.Abs(x1 - x0);
        int dy = Mathf.Abs(y1 - y0);
        int sx = x0 < x1 ? 1 : -1;
        int sy = y0 < y1 ? 1 : -1;
        int err = dx - dy;

        while (true)
        {
            // 检测以 (x0, y0) 为中心，边长为 (2*checkRadius+1) 的正方形区域
            bool blocked = false;
            for (int ox = -checkRadius; ox <= checkRadius; ox++)
            {
                for (int oy = -checkRadius; oy <= checkRadius; oy++)
                {
                    int checkX = x0 + ox;
                    int checkY = y0 + oy;
                    if (!IsWalkable(checkX, checkY))
                    {
                        blocked = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (blocked) break;
            }
            if (blocked) return false;

            // 到达终点
            if (x0 == x1 && y0 == y1) break;

            // Bresenham 步进
            int oldX = x0, oldY = y0;
            int e2 = 2 * err;
            bool changedX = false, changedY = false;

            if (e2 > -dy) { err -= dy; x0 += sx; changedX = true; }
            if (e2 < dx) { err += dx; y0 += sy; changedY = true; }

            // 斜角阻塞检测（防止穿墙角）
            if (changedX && changedY)
            {
                if (!IsWalkable(oldX + sx, oldY) || !IsWalkable(oldX, oldY + sy))
                    return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    // ========== A* 寻路（8方向，含对角线）==========
    private class Node
    {
        public Vector2Int pos;
        public Node parent;
        public int gCost;
        public int hCost;
        public int FCost => gCost + hCost;
    }

    // 8 方向：上/下/左/右 代价 10，对角线 代价 14（√10≈2）
    private static readonly Vector2Int[] Directions = {
        new Vector2Int(0, 1),   new Vector2Int(0, -1),
        new Vector2Int(-1, 0),  new Vector2Int(1, 0),
        new Vector2Int(-1, 1),  new Vector2Int(1, 1),
        new Vector2Int(-1, -1), new Vector2Int(1, -1),
    };
    private static readonly int[] DirectionCosts = { 10, 10, 10, 10, 14, 14, 14, 14 };

    // 对角线启发函数（Octile 距离）
    private static int Heuristic(Vector2Int a, Vector2Int b)
    {
        int dx = Mathf.Abs(a.x - b.x);
        int dy = Mathf.Abs(a.y - b.y);
        return 10 * Mathf.Max(dx, dy) + 4 * Mathf.Min(dx, dy);
    }

    /// <summary> A* 寻路，返回世界坐标路径点列表 </summary>
    public List<Vector3> FindPath(Vector3 startWorld, Vector3 targetWorld)
    {
        Vector2Int start = WorldToGridIndex(startWorld);
        Vector2Int target = WorldToGridIndex(targetWorld);

        // 起点或终点不可通行时，找最近可通行点
        if (!IsWalkable(start)) start = FindNearestWalkable(start);
        if (!IsWalkable(target)) target = FindNearestWalkable(target);
        if (!IsWalkable(start) || !IsWalkable(target)) return null;
        if (start == target) return new List<Vector3> { GridIndexToWorld(start) };

        var openList = new List<Node>();
        var openDict = new Dictionary<Vector2Int, Node>(); // O(1) 查找
        var closedSet = new HashSet<Vector2Int>();

        Node startNode = new Node { pos = start, gCost = 0, hCost = Heuristic(start, target) };
        openList.Add(startNode);
        openDict[start] = startNode;

        while (openList.Count > 0)
        {
            // 取 F 值最小的节点
            int currentIndex = 0;
            Node current = openList[0];
            for (int i = 1; i < openList.Count; i++)
            {
                if (openList[i].FCost < current.FCost ||
                    (openList[i].FCost == current.FCost && openList[i].hCost < current.hCost))
                {
                    current = openList[i];
                    currentIndex = i;
                }
            }

            openList.RemoveAt(currentIndex);
            openDict.Remove(current.pos);
            closedSet.Add(current.pos);

            // 到达目标，回溯路径
            if (current.pos == target)
            {
                List<Vector3> path = new List<Vector3>();
                Node node = current;
                while (node != null)
                {
                    path.Add(GridIndexToWorld(node.pos));
                    node = node.parent;
                }
                path.Reverse();
                return path;
            }

            // 遍历 8 个方向
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
            {
                Vector2Int neighborPos = current.pos + Directions[i];

                if (closedSet.Contains(neighborPos) || !IsWalkable(neighborPos)) continue;

                // 对角线移动时，检查两侧格子是否可通行（防止穿墙角）
                if (i >= 4)
                {
                    Vector2Int side1 = new Vector2Int(current.pos.x + Directions[i].x, current.pos.y);
                    Vector2Int side2 = new Vector2Int(current.pos.x, current.pos.y + Directions[i].y);
                    if (!IsWalkable(side1) || !IsWalkable(side2)) continue;
                }

                int newGCost = current.gCost + DirectionCosts[i];

                if (openDict.TryGetValue(neighborPos, out Node existing))
                {
                    if (newGCost < existing.gCost)
                    {
                        existing.gCost = newGCost;
                        existing.parent = current;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    Node neighbor = new Node
                    {
                        pos = neighborPos,
                        parent = current,
                        gCost = newGCost,
                        hCost = Heuristic(neighborPos, target)
                    };
                    openList.Add(neighbor);
                    openDict[neighborPos] = neighbor;
                }
            }
        }

        return null; // 找不到路径
    }

    // ========== 最近可达点（A* 找不到路时的备用）==========
    public Vector2Int FindNearestWalkable(Vector2Int target)
    {
        if (IsWalkable(target)) return target;

        for (int radius = 1; radius < 20; radius++)
        {
            for (int dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++)
            {
                for (int dy = -radius; dy <= radius; dy++)
                {
                    if (Mathf.Abs(dx) != radius && Mathf.Abs(dy) != radius) continue;
                    Vector2Int checkPos = target + new Vector2Int(dx, dy);
                    if (IsWalkable(checkPos)) return checkPos;
                }
            }
        }
        return target; // 保底
    }

using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// 地牢生成器 — BFS邻接放置房间，共享墙壁开门洞，无走廊。
/// </summary>
public class DungeonGenerator
{
    public List<List<RoomData>> Layers { get; private set; } = new();
    public TileGrid GlobalGrid { get; private set; }

    private DungeonConfig _config;
    private TilePrototype[] _allProtos;
    private TilePrototype _wallProto;
    private TilePrototype _floorProto;
    private TilePrototype _doorProto;

    public DungeonGenerator(DungeonConfig config, TilePrototype[] allProtos,
        TilePrototype wallProto, TilePrototype floorProto, TilePrototype doorProto)
    {
        _config = config;
        _allProtos = allProtos;
        _wallProto = wallProto;
        _floorProto = floorProto;
        _doorProto = doorProto;
    }

    public TileGrid Generate(int seed = 0)
    {
        if (seed != 0) Random.InitState(seed);

        GlobalGrid = new TileGrid(_config.maxMapWidth, _config.maxMapHeight, Vector2Int.zero, _config.tileSize);

        for (int layer = 0; layer < _config.layerCount; layer++)
        {
            Debug.Log($"Layer {layer + 1}/{_config.layerCount}");
            var rooms = GenerateLayer(layer);
            Layers.Add(rooms);

            foreach (var room in rooms)
                if (room.TileGrid != null)
                    GlobalGrid.Blit(room.TileGrid, room.Position.x, room.Position.y);

            MergeAdjacentRooms(rooms);
        }

        return GlobalGrid;
    }

    // ==================== BFS 邻接放置 ====================

    private List<RoomData> GenerateLayer(int layerIndex)
    {
        var rooms = new List<RoomData>();
        int count = _config.roomsPerLayer;
        if (count == 0) return rooms;

        // 房间 0: 起始房间，居中放置
        int layerOffsetY = layerIndex * (_config.roomMaxHeight * 3);
        int cx = _config.maxMapWidth / 2;
        int cy = 10 + layerOffsetY;

        RoomType t0 = RoomType.Start;
        int w0 = Random.Range(_config.roomMinWidth, _config.roomMaxWidth + 1);
        int h0 = Random.Range(_config.roomMinHeight, _config.roomMaxHeight + 1);
        var room0 = RoomGenerator.Generate(w0, h0, new Vector2Int(cx - w0 / 2, cy), t0,
            _allProtos, _wallProto, _floorProto, _doorProto);
        if (room0.TileGrid != null) rooms.Add(room0);

        // BFS 队列
        var queue = new Queue<int>();
        queue.Enqueue(0);

        while (rooms.Count < count && queue.Count > 0)
        {
            int parentIdx = queue.Dequeue();
            var parent = rooms[parentIdx];

            // 尝试在四个方向放置子房间
            var sides = new[] { (0, -1), (0, 1), (-1, 0), (1, 0) }; // N S W E
            Shuffle(sides);

            foreach (var (sx, sy) in sides)
            {
                if (rooms.Count >= count) break;

                RoomType type = rooms.Count == count - 1 ? RoomType.Exit
                    : (Random.value < 0.15f ? RoomType.Treasure : RoomType.Normal);

                int w = Random.Range(_config.roomMinWidth, _config.roomMaxWidth + 1);
                int h = Random.Range(_config.roomMinHeight, _config.roomMaxHeight + 1);

                Vector2Int pos = CalcAdjacentPos(parent, w, h, sx, sy);

                if (pos.x < 0 || !IsPositionFree(rooms, pos, w, h)) continue;

                var room = RoomGenerator.Generate(w, h, pos, type,
                    _allProtos, _wallProto, _floorProto, _doorProto);
                if (room.TileGrid != null)
                {
                    rooms.Add(room);
                    queue.Enqueue(rooms.Count - 1);
                }
            }
        }

        // 如果房间数不够，随机散放剩余
        while (rooms.Count < count)
        {
            RoomType type = rooms.Count == count - 1 ? RoomType.Exit
                : (Random.value < 0.15f ? RoomType.Treasure : RoomType.Normal);
            int w = Random.Range(_config.roomMinWidth, _config.roomMaxWidth + 1);
            int h = Random.Range(_config.roomMinHeight, _config.roomMaxHeight + 1);

            Vector2Int pos = ScatterPosition(rooms, w, h, layerOffsetY);
            if (pos.x < 0) { w = Mathf.Max(_config.roomMinWidth, w - 2); h = Mathf.Max(_config.roomMinHeight, h - 2); pos = ScatterPosition(rooms, w, h, layerOffsetY); }
            if (pos.x < 0) break;

            var room = RoomGenerator.Generate(w, h, pos, type, _allProtos, _wallProto, _floorProto, _doorProto);
            if (room.TileGrid != null) rooms.Add(room);
        }

        return rooms;
    }

    private Vector2Int CalcAdjacentPos(RoomData parent, int w, int h, int sx, int sy)
    {
        // sx,sy: (-1,0)=左 (1,0)=右 (0,1)=上 (0,-1)=下
        int px = parent.Position.x;
        int py = parent.Position.y;
        int pw = parent.Width;
        int ph = parent.Height;

        // 对齐中心
        int centerP = (sx != 0) ? (py + ph / 2) : (px + pw / 2);
        int centerN = (sx != 0) ? (h / 2) : (w / 2);
        int align = centerP - centerN;

        if (sx == -1) return new Vector2Int(px - w, align);              // 左边
        if (sx == 1) return new Vector2Int(px + pw, align);             // 右边
        if (sy == -1) return new Vector2Int(align, py - h);              // 上边
        return new Vector2Int(align, py + ph);                          // 下边
    }

    private bool IsPositionFree(List<RoomData> rooms, Vector2Int pos, int w, int h)
    {
        if (pos.x < 0 || pos.y < 0 || pos.x + w > _config.maxMapWidth || pos.y + h > _config.maxMapHeight)
            return false;

        var rect = new RectInt(pos.x, pos.y, w, h);
        foreach (var r in rooms)
            if (rect.Overlaps(r.Bounds)) return false;
        return true;
    }

    private Vector2Int ScatterPosition(List<RoomData> rooms, int w, int h, int layerOffset)
    {
        for (int a = 0; a < 50; a++)
        {
            int x = Random.Range(2, _config.maxMapWidth - w - 2);
            int y = Random.Range(2 + layerOffset, Mathf.Min(layerOffset + _config.roomMaxHeight * 4, _config.maxMapHeight - h - 2));
            if (IsPositionFree(rooms, new Vector2Int(x, y), w, h))
                return new Vector2Int(x, y);
        }
        return new Vector2Int(-1, -1);
    }

    // ==================== 共享墙壁合并 ====================

    private void MergeAdjacentRooms(List<RoomData> rooms)
    {
        int floorIdx = System.Array.IndexOf(_allProtos, _floorProto);
        int doorIdx = System.Array.IndexOf(_allProtos, _doorProto);
        if (floorIdx < 0) floorIdx = 0;
        if (doorIdx < 0) doorIdx = 0;

        var floorTile = new TileData { prototypeIndex = floorIdx, walkable = true, category = TilePrototype.Category.Floor };
        var doorTile = new TileData { prototypeIndex = doorIdx, walkable = true, category = TilePrototype.Category.Door };

        for (int i = 0; i < rooms.Count; i++)
        {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < rooms.Count; j++)
            {
                var a = rooms[i];
                var b = rooms[j];

                var overlap = GetSharedBorder(a, b);
                if (overlap.valid)
                {
                    // 在共享边上开门洞：取中间 ~1/3 长度
                    int len = overlap.end - overlap.start + 1;
                    int doorLen = Mathf.Max(1, len / 3);
                    int doorStart = overlap.start + (len - doorLen) / 2;

                    for (int k = doorStart; k < doorStart + doorLen; k++)
                    {
                        int gx = overlap.isX ? k : overlap.fixedCoord;
                        int gy = overlap.isX ? overlap.fixedCoord : k;

                        // 替换共享边两侧的墙壁为门
                        ReplaceWallWith(GlobalGrid, gx, gy, doorTile);
                        // 对应的对面格子（另一个房间的内部边缘）
                        if (overlap.isX)
                            ReplaceWallWith(GlobalGrid, gx, gy + overlap.dirSign, doorTile);
                        else
                            ReplaceWallWith(GlobalGrid, gx + overlap.dirSign, gy, doorTile);

                        // 也确认相邻的 floor tiles 连通
                        if (overlap.isX)
                        {
                            SetIfEmpty(GlobalGrid, gx, gy + 1, floorTile);
                            SetIfEmpty(GlobalGrid, gx, gy - 1, floorTile);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            SetIfEmpty(GlobalGrid, gx + 1, gy, floorTile);
                            SetIfEmpty(GlobalGrid, gx - 1, gy, floorTile);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private (bool valid, bool isX, int fixedCoord, int start, int end, int dirSign)
        GetSharedBorder(RoomData a, RoomData b)
    {
        var ra = a.Bounds;
        var rb = b.Bounds;

        // 检查水平相邻（a在左，b在右，或b在左，a在右）
        if (ra.xMax == rb.xMin && ra.yMax > rb.yMin && ra.yMin < rb.yMax)
        {
            int yStart = Mathf.Max(ra.yMin, rb.yMin);
            int yEnd = Mathf.Min(ra.yMax, rb.yMax) - 1;
            if (yEnd >= yStart)
                return (true, false, ra.xMax, yStart, yEnd, 0); // isX=false, vertical border at x=ra.xMax
        }
        if (rb.xMax == ra.xMin && ra.yMax > rb.yMin && ra.yMin < rb.yMax)
        {
            int yStart = Mathf.Max(ra.yMin, rb.yMin);
            int yEnd = Mathf.Min(ra.yMax, rb.yMax) - 1;
            if (yEnd >= yStart)
                return (true, false, ra.xMin, yStart, yEnd, 0);
        }

        // 检查垂直相邻
        if (ra.yMax == rb.yMin && ra.xMax > rb.xMin && ra.xMin < rb.xMax)
        {
            int xStart = Mathf.Max(ra.xMin, rb.xMin);
            int xEnd = Mathf.Min(ra.xMax, rb.xMax) - 1;
            if (xEnd >= xStart)
                return (true, true, ra.yMax, xStart, xEnd, 1); // isX=true, horizontal border at y=ra.yMax
        }
        if (rb.yMax == ra.yMin && ra.xMax > rb.xMin && ra.xMin < rb.xMax)
        {
            int xStart = Mathf.Max(ra.xMin, rb.xMin);
            int xEnd = Mathf.Min(ra.xMax, rb.xMax) - 1;
            if (xEnd >= xStart)
                return (true, true, ra.yMin, xStart, xEnd, -1);
        }

        return (false, false, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    }

    private void ReplaceWallWith(TileGrid grid, int x, int y, TileData newTile)
    {
        if (!grid.InBounds(x, y)) return;
        var tile = grid.GetTile(x, y);
        if (tile.category == TilePrototype.Category.Wall)
            grid.SetTile(x, y, newTile);
    }

    private void SetIfEmpty(TileGrid grid, int x, int y, TileData tile)
    {
        if (!grid.InBounds(x, y)) return;
        if (grid.GetTile(x, y).IsEmpty)
            grid.SetTile(x, y, tile);
    }

    private static void Shuffle<T>(T[] arr)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.Length; i++)
        {
            int j = Random.Range(i, arr.Length);
            (arr[i], arr[j]) = (arr[j], arr[i]);
        }
    }

    public static RoomData Generate(int width, int height, Vector2Int position, RoomType type,

        {

            Position = position,
            Type = type
        };

        var fixedCells = new Dictionary<Vector2Int, TilePrototype>();
        for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
        {
            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
            {
                bool isBorder = x == 0 || x == width - 1 || y == 0 || y == height - 1;
                if (isBorder)
                    fixedCells[new Vector2Int(x, y)] = wallProto;
            }
        }

        var wfc = new WaveFunctionCollapse(prototypes);
        room.TileGrid = wfc.Collapse(width, height, position, fixedCells);

        return room;
    }

using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// 2D 瓦片网格 — 纯数据，提供读写和查询。
/// </summary>
public class TileGrid
{
    public int Width { get; private set; }
    public int Height { get; private set; }
    public Vector2Int Origin { get; private set; }
    public float TileSize { get; private set; }

    private TileData[,] _tiles;

    public TileGrid(int width, int height, Vector2Int origin, float tileSize = 1f)
    {
        Width = width;
        Height = height;
        Origin = origin;
        TileSize = tileSize;
        _tiles = new TileData[width, height];
        for (int x = 0; x < width; x++)
            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
                _tiles[x, y] = TileData.Empty;
    }

    public TileData GetTile(int x, int y)
    {
        if (!InBounds(x, y)) return TileData.Empty;
        return _tiles[x, y];
    }

    public void SetTile(int x, int y, TileData data)
    {
        if (!InBounds(x, y)) return;
        _tiles[x, y] = data;
    }

    public bool InBounds(int x, int y) => x >= 0 && x < Width && y >= 0 && y < Height;

    public bool IsWalkable(int x, int y)
    {
        if (!InBounds(x, y)) return false;
        return _tiles[x, y].walkable && !_tiles[x, y].IsEmpty;
    }

    public Vector3 GridToWorld(int x, int y)
    {
        float cx = Origin.x + (x + 0.5f) * TileSize;
        float cy = Origin.y - (y + 0.5f) * TileSize;
        return new Vector3(cx, cy, 0f);
    }

    public Vector2Int WorldToGrid(Vector3 worldPos)
    {
        int x = Mathf.FloorToInt((worldPos.x - Origin.x) / TileSize);
        int y = Mathf.FloorToInt((Origin.y - worldPos.y) / TileSize);
        return new Vector2Int(x, y);
    }

    public TileGrid GetRegion(int x, int y, int w, int h)
    {
        var region = new TileGrid(w, h, new Vector2Int(Origin.x + x, Origin.y - y), TileSize);
        for (int rx = 0; rx < w; rx++)
            for (int ry = 0; ry < h; ry++)
                region._tiles[rx, ry] = GetTile(x + rx, y + ry);
        return region;
    }

    public void Blit(TileGrid src, int dstX, int dstY)
    {
        for (int x = 0; x < src.Width; x++)
            for (int y = 0; y < src.Height; y++)
                SetTile(dstX + x, dstY + y, src._tiles[x, y]);
    }

    public bool HasLineOfSight(Vector2Int a, Vector2Int b, float radiusCells)
    {
        int dx = Mathf.Abs(b.x - a.x);
        int dy = Mathf.Abs(b.y - a.y);
        int sx = a.x < b.x ? 1 : -1;
        int sy = a.y < b.y ? 1 : -1;
        int err = dx - dy;
        int x = a.x, y = a.y;
        int steps = dx + dy;

        for (int i = 0; i <= steps; i++)
        {
            int r = Mathf.CeilToInt(radiusCells);
            bool blocked = false;
            for (int ox = -r; ox <= r && !blocked; ox++)
                for (int oy = -r; oy <= r && !blocked; oy++)
                    if (!IsWalkable(x + ox, y + oy)) blocked = true;
            if (blocked) return false;
            if (x == b.x && y == b.y) return true;
            int e2 = 2 * err;
            if (e2 > -dy) { err -= dy; x += sx; }
            if (e2 < dx) { err += dx; y += sy; }
        }
        return true;
    }

    // A* 寻路，8-direction
    private static readonly Vector2Int[] _dirs8 = {
        new(0,1), new(1,1), new(1,0), new(1,-1),
        new(0,-1), new(-1,-1), new(-1,0), new(-1,1)
    };
    private static readonly int[] _costs = { 10, 14, 10, 14, 10, 14, 10, 14 };

    public List<Vector2Int> FindPath(Vector2Int start, Vector2Int end)
    {
        if (!IsWalkable(end.x, end.y))
            end = FindNearestWalkable(end);
        if (!IsWalkable(start.x, start.y) || !IsWalkable(end.x, end.y))
            return null;

        var open = new List<(int f, Vector2Int pos)>();
        var cameFrom = new Dictionary<Vector2Int, Vector2Int>();
        var gScore = new Dictionary<Vector2Int, int>();
        var closed = new HashSet<Vector2Int>();

        gScore[start] = 0;
        open.Add((Heuristic(start, end), start));

        while (open.Count > 0)
        {
            open.Sort((a, b) => a.f.CompareTo(b.f));
            var current = open[0].pos;
            open.RemoveAt(0);
            if (current == end) return ReconstructPath(cameFrom, current);
            closed.Add(current);

            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
            {
                var neighbor = current + _dirs8[i];
                if (closed.Contains(neighbor) || !IsWalkable(neighbor.x, neighbor.y)) continue;
                if (i == 1 || i == 3 || i == 5 || i == 7)
                {
                    var d = _dirs8[i];
                    if (!IsWalkable(current.x + d.x, current.y) ||
                        !IsWalkable(current.x, current.y + d.y)) continue;
                }

                int tentative = gScore[current] + _costs[i];
                if (!gScore.ContainsKey(neighbor) || tentative < gScore[neighbor])
                {
                    gScore[neighbor] = tentative;
                    cameFrom[neighbor] = current;
                    int f = tentative + Heuristic(neighbor, end);
                    int idx = open.FindIndex(o => o.pos == neighbor);
                    if (idx >= 0) open[idx] = (f, neighbor);
                    else open.Add((f, neighbor));
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private List<Vector2Int> ReconstructPath(Dictionary<Vector2Int, Vector2Int> cameFrom, Vector2Int current)
    {
        var path = new List<Vector2Int> { current };
        while (cameFrom.ContainsKey(current))
        {
            current = cameFrom[current];
            path.Add(current);
        }
        path.Reverse();
        return path;
    }

    private int Heuristic(Vector2Int a, Vector2Int b)
    {
        int dx = Mathf.Abs(a.x - b.x);
        int dy = Mathf.Abs(a.y - b.y);
        return 10 * Mathf.Max(dx, dy) + 4 * Mathf.Min(dx, dy);
    }

    private Vector2Int FindNearestWalkable(Vector2Int pos)
    {
        for (int r = 1; r <= 20; r++)
            for (int ox = -r; ox <= r; ox++)
                for (int oy = -r; oy <= r; oy++)
                {
                    var p = new Vector2Int(pos.x + ox, pos.y + oy);
                    if (IsWalkable(p.x, p.y)) return p;
                }
        return pos;
    }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using Random = UnityEngine.Random;

/// <summary>
/// 波函数坍塌 — 纯算法，输入原型集 + 尺寸 + 约束 → 输出 TileGrid。
/// </summary>
public class WaveFunctionCollapse
{
    private TilePrototype[] _prototypes;
    private int _width, _height;
    private bool[][,] _possible;      // _possible[p][x,y] = 原型p在(x,y)是否可能
    private int[,] _entropy;         // 每个cell的可能原型数
    private int[,] _collapsed;       // -1=未坍塌 其他=原型索引
    private TilePrototype[,] _initialFixed; // 初始化时固定的瓦片(约束)

    private static readonly Vector2Int[] _dirs = { Vector2Int.up, Vector2Int.down, Vector2Int.right, Vector2Int.left };
    private int _totalCells, _collapsedCount;
    private int _maxAttempts;

    public WaveFunctionCollapse(TilePrototype[] prototypes, int maxAttempts = 50)
    {
        _prototypes = prototypes;
        _maxAttempts = maxAttempts;
    }

    /// <summary>执行坍塌，返回生成的 TileGrid，失败返回 null</summary>
    public TileGrid Collapse(int width, int height, Vector2Int origin,
        Dictionary<Vector2Int, TilePrototype> fixedCells = null)
    {
        for (int attempt = 0; attempt < _maxAttempts; attempt++)
        {
            var result = TryCollapse(width, height, origin, fixedCells);
            if (result != null) return result;
            Debug.LogWarning($"WFC attempt {attempt + 1} failed, retrying...");
        }
        Debug.LogError("WFC: all attempts exhausted");
        return null;
    }

    private TileGrid TryCollapse(int width, int height, Vector2Int origin,
        Dictionary<Vector2Int, TilePrototype> fixedCells)
    {
        _width = width;
        _height = height;
        _totalCells = width * height;
        _collapsedCount = 0;

        InitializeData(fixedCells);

        while (_collapsedCount < _totalCells)
        {
            // 找最低熵 cell
            var cell = FindLowestEntropy();
            if (cell.x < 0) return null; // 矛盾

            // 坍塌
            if (!CollapseCell(cell.x, cell.y)) return null;

            // 传播约束
            if (!Propagate(cell.x, cell.y)) return null;
        }

        return BuildTileGrid(origin);
    }

    private void InitializeData(Dictionary<Vector2Int, TilePrototype> fixedCells)
    {
        _possible = new bool[_prototypes.Length][,];
        _entropy = new int[_width, _height];
        _collapsed = new int[_width, _height];
        _initialFixed = new TilePrototype[_width, _height];

        // 初始化所有cell为全部原型可能
        for (int p = 0; p < _prototypes.Length; p++)
        {
            _possible[p] = new bool[_width, _height];
            for (int x = 0; x < _width; x++)
                for (int y = 0; y < _height; y++)
                    _possible[p][x, y] = true;
        }

        // 初始熵 = 原型数
        for (int x = 0; x < _width; x++)
            for (int y = 0; y < _height; y++)
            {
                _entropy[x, y] = _prototypes.Length;
                _collapsed[x, y] = -1;
            }

        // 应用固定约束
        if (fixedCells != null)
        {
            foreach (var kv in fixedCells)
            {
                int x = kv.Key.x, y = kv.Key.y;
                if (x >= 0 && x < _width && y >= 0 && y < _height)
                {
                    int idx = Array.IndexOf(_prototypes, kv.Value);
                    if (idx >= 0)
                    {
                        ForceCollapse(x, y, idx);
                        _initialFixed[x, y] = kv.Value;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void ForceCollapse(int x, int y, int prototypeIndex)
    {
        for (int p = 0; p < _prototypes.Length; p++)
            _possible[p][x, y] = (p == prototypeIndex);
        _entropy[x, y] = 1;
    }

    private Vector2Int FindLowestEntropy()
    {
        int minEntropy = int.MaxValue;
        var candidates = new List<Vector2Int>();

        for (int x = 0; x < _width; x++)
        {
            for (int y = 0; y < _height; y++)
            {
                if (_collapsed[x, y] >= 0) continue;
                if (_entropy[x, y] == 0) return new Vector2Int(-1, -1); // 矛盾
                if (_entropy[x, y] < minEntropy)
                {
                    minEntropy = _entropy[x, y];
                    candidates.Clear();
                    candidates.Add(new Vector2Int(x, y));
                }
                else if (_entropy[x, y] == minEntropy)
                {
                    candidates.Add(new Vector2Int(x, y));
                }
            }
        }

        return candidates.Count > 0 ? candidates[Random.Range(0, candidates.Count)] : new Vector2Int(-1, -1);
    }

    private bool CollapseCell(int x, int y)
    {
        // 收集可能的原型及权重
        float totalWeight = 0f;
        var weighted = new List<(int idx, float weight)>();
        for (int p = 0; p < _prototypes.Length; p++)
        {
            if (_possible[p][x, y])
            {
                totalWeight += _prototypes[p].weight;
                weighted.Add((p, _prototypes[p].weight));
            }
        }

        if (weighted.Count == 0) return false;

        // 按权重随机选择
        float r = Random.Range(0f, totalWeight);
        float accum = 0f;
        int chosen = weighted[0].idx;
        foreach (var w in weighted)
        {
            accum += w.weight;
            if (r <= accum) { chosen = w.idx; break; }
        }

        _collapsed[x, y] = chosen;
        _collapsedCount++;

        // 更新该cell的可能状态
        for (int p = 0; p < _prototypes.Length; p++)
            _possible[p][x, y] = (p == chosen);
        _entropy[x, y] = 1;

        return true;
    }

    private bool Propagate(int startX, int startY)
    {
        var queue = new Queue<Vector2Int>();
        queue.Enqueue(new Vector2Int(startX, startY));

        while (queue.Count > 0)
        {
            var cell = queue.Dequeue();
            if (_collapsed[cell.x, cell.y] < 0) continue;

            int collapsedProto = _collapsed[cell.x, cell.y];

            foreach (var dir in _dirs)
            {
                int nx = cell.x + dir.x;
                int ny = cell.y + dir.y;
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= _width || ny < 0 || ny >= _height) continue;
                if (_collapsed[nx, ny] >= 0) continue;

                // 筛选邻居可能原型：必须与已坍塌的cell兼容
                bool anyRemoved = false;
                for (int p = 0; p < _prototypes.Length; p++)
                {
                    if (!_possible[p][nx, ny]) continue;
                    if (!TilePrototype.CanConnect(_prototypes[collapsedProto], _prototypes[p], dir))
                    {
                        _possible[p][nx, ny] = false;
                        anyRemoved = true;
                    }
                }

                if (anyRemoved)
                {
                    int newEntropy = 0;
                    for (int p = 0; p < _prototypes.Length; p++)
                        if (_possible[p][nx, ny]) newEntropy++;

                    if (newEntropy == 0) return false; // 矛盾
                    _entropy[nx, ny] = newEntropy;
                    queue.Enqueue(new Vector2Int(nx, ny));
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private TileGrid BuildTileGrid(Vector2Int origin)
    {
        var grid = new TileGrid(_width, _height, origin);
        for (int x = 0; x < _width; x++)
            for (int y = 0; y < _height; y++)
            {

    void Awake()
    {
        _rb = GetComponent<Rigidbody2D>();
        _combat = GetComponent<PlayerCombat>();
        _stats = GetComponent<PlayerStats>();

#if UNITY_EDITOR
        if (_rb == null)
            Debug.LogWarning("PlayerController: 未找到 Rigidbody2D 组件");
